+package kgateway

+// ConsistentHash configures the hash policies used to compute the hash key for
+// consistent hashing load balancers. Hash policies are evaluated in the following
+// order: headers, cookies, queryParameters, filterState, sourceIp.
+// If no fields are set, the request's source IP is used as the hash key.
+//
+// +kubebuilder:validation:XValidation:rule="!has(self.disable) || !self.disable || (!has(self.headers) && !has(self.cookies) && !has(self.queryParameters) && !has(self.filterState) && !has(self.sourceIp))",message="no other fields may be set when disable is true"
+type ConsistentHash struct {
+	// Disable suppresses consistent hashing for the targeted route, including any hash
+	// policies inherited from policies attached at a broader scope.
+	// When true, no other fields may be set.
+	// +optional
+	Disable *bool `json:"disable,omitempty"`
+
+	// Headers specifies request headers whose values are used as components of the hash key.
+	// Entries are deduplicated by headerName (case-insensitive); only the first occurrence is kept.
+	// +optional
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MinItems=1
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MaxItems=16
+	Headers []ConsistentHashHeader `json:"headers,omitempty"`
+
+	// Cookies specifies cookies whose values are used as components of the hash key.
+	// Entries are deduplicated by name; only the first occurrence is kept.
+	// +optional
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MinItems=1
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MaxItems=16
+	Cookies []ConsistentHashCookie `json:"cookies,omitempty"`
+
+	// QueryParameters specifies URL query parameters whose values are used as components of the hash key.
+	// Entries are deduplicated by name; only the first occurrence is kept.
+	// +optional
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MinItems=1
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MaxItems=16
+	QueryParameters []ConsistentHashQueryParameter `json:"queryParameters,omitempty"`
+
+	// FilterState specifies filter state objects whose values are used as components of the hash key.
+	// Entries are deduplicated by key; only the first occurrence is kept.
+	// +optional
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MinItems=1
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MaxItems=16
+	FilterState []ConsistentHashFilterState `json:"filterState,omitempty"`
+
+	// SourceIP uses the request's source IP address as a component of the hash key.
+	// +optional
+	SourceIP *ConsistentHashSourceIP `json:"sourceIp,omitempty"`
+}
+
+// ConsistentHashHeader uses a request header's value as a component of the hash key.
+type ConsistentHashHeader struct {
+	// HeaderName is the name of the request header to hash.
+	// +required
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MinLength=1
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MaxLength=256
+	HeaderName string `json:"headerName"`
+
+	// RegexRewrite rewrites the header value using a regular expression before hashing.
+	// +optional
+	RegexRewrite *ConsistentHashRegexRewrite `json:"regexRewrite,omitempty"`
+
+	// Terminal, if true and a hash key is available after evaluating this policy, causes
+	// subsequent hash policies to be skipped.
+	// +optional
+	Terminal *bool `json:"terminal,omitempty"`
+}
+
+// ConsistentHashRegexRewrite rewrites a value using a regular expression.
+type ConsistentHashRegexRewrite struct {
+	// Pattern is the RE2 regular expression to match against the value.
+	// +required
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MinLength=1
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MaxLength=1024
+	Pattern string `json:"pattern"`
+
+	// Substitution is the replacement string for matched portions of the value.
+	// It may contain numbered capture group references (e.g. \1).
+	// +required
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MaxLength=1024
+	Substitution string `json:"substitution"`
+}
+
+// ConsistentHashCookie uses a cookie's value as a component of the hash key.
+type ConsistentHashCookie struct {
+	// Name is the name of the cookie.
+	// +required
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MinLength=1
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MaxLength=256
+	Name string `json:"name"`
+
+	// TTL specifies the time to live of the cookie. If specified, a cookie with this TTL
+	// will be generated if the cookie is not present. If zero, the generated cookie
+	// is a session cookie.
+	// Accepts a Go duration string (e.g. "1h30m") or an integer number of seconds (e.g. "3600").
+	// +optional
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:Pattern=`^([0-9]+|([0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?(ns|us|µs|ms|s|m|h))+)$`
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MaxLength=64
+	TTL *string `json:"ttl,omitempty"`
+
+	// Path is the path for the generated cookie.
+	// +optional
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MaxLength=1024
+	Path *string `json:"path,omitempty"`
+
+	// Attributes are additional attributes (e.g. SameSite, Secure) set on the generated cookie.
+	// +optional
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MaxItems=16
+	Attributes []ConsistentHashCookieAttribute `json:"attributes,omitempty"`
+
+	// Terminal, if true and a hash key is available after evaluating this policy, causes
+	// subsequent hash policies to be skipped.
+	// +optional
+	Terminal *bool `json:"terminal,omitempty"`
+}
+
+// ConsistentHashCookieAttribute is an attribute of a generated cookie.
+type ConsistentHashCookieAttribute struct {
+	// Name is the name of the cookie attribute.
+	// +required
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MinLength=1
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MaxLength=256
+	Name string `json:"name"`
+
+	// Value is the value of the cookie attribute.
+	// +optional
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MaxLength=1024
+	Value *string `json:"value,omitempty"`
+}
+
+// ConsistentHashQueryParameter uses a URL query parameter's value as a component of the hash key.
+type ConsistentHashQueryParameter struct {
+	// Name is the name of the query parameter.
+	// +required
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MinLength=1
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MaxLength=256
+	Name string `json:"name"`
+
+	// Terminal, if true and a hash key is available after evaluating this policy, causes
+	// subsequent hash policies to be skipped.
+	// +optional
+	Terminal *bool `json:"terminal,omitempty"`
+}
+
+// ConsistentHashFilterState uses a filter state object as a component of the hash key.
+type ConsistentHashFilterState struct {
+	// Key is the name of the filter state object to hash.
+	// The object must implement hashing.
+	// +required
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MinLength=1
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MaxLength=256
+	Key string `json:"key"`
+
+	// Terminal, if true and a hash key is available after evaluating this policy, causes
+	// subsequent hash policies to be skipped.
+	// +optional
+	Terminal *bool `json:"terminal,omitempty"`
+}
+
+// ConsistentHashSourceIP uses the request's source IP address as a component of the hash key.
+type ConsistentHashSourceIP struct {
+	// Terminal, if true and a hash key is available after evaluating this policy, causes
+	// subsequent hash policies to be skipped.
+	// +optional
+	Terminal *bool `json:"terminal,omitempty"`
+}

+	// disable suppresses all hash policies on the route
+	disable bool
+
+	headers         []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+	cookies         []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+	queryParameters []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+	filterState     []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+	sourceIP        *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+
+	// hashPolicies is the final list of hash policies to apply to the RouteAction,
+	// derived from the fields above in canonical type order.
+	hashPolicies []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+}
+
+var _ PolicySubIR = &consistentHashIR{}
+
+func (c *consistentHashIR) Equals(other PolicySubIR) bool {
+	otherConsistentHash, ok := other.(*consistentHashIR)
+	if !ok {
+		return false
+	}
+	if c == nil && otherConsistentHash == nil {
+		return true
+	}
+	if c == nil || otherConsistentHash == nil {
+		return false
+	}
+	if c.disable != otherConsistentHash.disable {
+		return false
+	}
+	if !hashPoliciesEqual(c.headers, otherConsistentHash.headers) ||
+		!hashPoliciesEqual(c.cookies, otherConsistentHash.cookies) ||
+		!hashPoliciesEqual(c.queryParameters, otherConsistentHash.queryParameters) ||
+		!hashPoliciesEqual(c.filterState, otherConsistentHash.filterState) ||
+		!hashPoliciesEqual(c.hashPolicies, otherConsistentHash.hashPolicies) {
+		return false
+	}
+	return proto.Equal(c.sourceIP, otherConsistentHash.sourceIP)
+}
+
+func hashPoliciesEqual(a, b []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy) bool {
+	return slices.EqualFunc(a, b, func(x, y *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy) bool {
+		return proto.Equal(x, y)
+	})
+}
+
+// Validate performs validation on the consistent hash component.
+func (c *consistentHashIR) Validate() error {
+	if c == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	for _, hp := range c.hashPolicies {
+		if rr := hp.GetHeader().GetRegexRewrite(); rr != nil {
+			if err := regexutils.CheckRegexString(rr.GetPattern().GetRegex()); err != nil {
+				return fmt.Errorf("invalid consistentHash header regexRewrite pattern: %w", err)
+			}
+		}
+		if err := hp.ValidateAll(); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+// constructConsistentHash constructs the consistent hash policy IR from the policy specification.
+func constructConsistentHash(spec kgateway.TrafficPolicySpec, out *trafficPolicySpecIr) error {
+	if spec.ConsistentHash == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	in := spec.ConsistentHash
+
+	ir := &consistentHashIR{}
+	if ptr.Deref(in.Disable, false) {
+		ir.disable = true
+		out.consistentHash = ir
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	for _, h := range in.Headers {
+		header := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Header{
+			HeaderName: h.HeaderName,
+		}
+		if h.RegexRewrite != nil {
+			header.RegexRewrite = &envoy_type_matcher_v3.RegexMatchAndSubstitute{
+				Pattern: &envoy_type_matcher_v3.RegexMatcher{
+					Regex: h.RegexRewrite.Pattern,
+				},
+				Substitution: h.RegexRewrite.Substitution,
+			}
+		}
+		ir.headers = append(ir.headers, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Header_{Header: header},
+			Terminal:        ptr.Deref(h.Terminal, false),
+		})
+	}
+
+	for _, c := range in.Cookies {
+		cookie := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Cookie{
+			Name: c.Name,
+			Path: ptr.Deref(c.Path, ""),
+		}
+		if c.TTL != nil {
+			ttl, err := parseCookieTTL(*c.TTL)
+			if err != nil {
+				return fmt.Errorf("invalid consistentHash cookie %q ttl: %w", c.Name, err)
+			}
+			cookie.Ttl = durationpb.New(ttl)
+		}
+		for _, attr := range c.Attributes {
+			cookie.Attributes = append(cookie.GetAttributes(), &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_CookieAttribute{
+				Name:  attr.Name,
+				Value: ptr.Deref(attr.Value, ""),
+			})
+		}
+		ir.cookies = append(ir.cookies, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Cookie_{Cookie: cookie},
+			Terminal:        ptr.Deref(c.Terminal, false),
+		})
+	}
+
+	for _, q := range in.QueryParameters {
+		ir.queryParameters = append(ir.queryParameters, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_QueryParameter_{
+				QueryParameter: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_QueryParameter{
+					Name: q.Name,
+				},
+			},
+			Terminal: ptr.Deref(q.Terminal, false),
+		})
+	}
+
+	for _, f := range in.FilterState {
+		ir.filterState = append(ir.filterState, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_FilterState_{
+				FilterState: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_FilterState{
+					Key: f.Key,
+				},
+			},
+			Terminal: ptr.Deref(f.Terminal, false),
+		})
+	}
+
+	if in.SourceIP != nil {
+		ir.sourceIP = sourceIPHashPolicy(ptr.Deref(in.SourceIP.Terminal, false))
+	}
+
+	ir.finalize()
+	out.consistentHash = ir
+	return nil
+}
+
+// parseCookieTTL parses a Go duration string (e.g. "1h30m") or an integer number of seconds (e.g. "3600").
+func parseCookieTTL(s string) (time.Duration, error) {
+	if secs, err := strconv.ParseInt(s, 10, 64); err == nil {
+		if secs < 0 {
+			return 0, fmt.Errorf("must not be negative: %q", s)
+		}
+		return time.Duration(secs) * time.Second, nil
+	}
+	d, err := time.ParseDuration(s)
+	if err != nil {
+		return 0, err
+	}
+	if d < 0 {
+		return 0, fmt.Errorf("must not be negative: %q", s)
+	}
+	return d, nil
+}
+
+func sourceIPHashPolicy(terminal bool) *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy {
+	return &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+		PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties_{
+			ConnectionProperties: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties{
+				SourceIp: true,
+			},
+		},
+		Terminal: terminal,
+	}
+}
+
+// finalize deduplicates each hash policy type by its identifying key and computes
+// the final list of hash policies in canonical type order:
+// headers, cookies, queryParameters, filterState, sourceIp.
+// If no hash policies are configured, a single non-terminal sourceIp hash policy is used.
+func (c *consistentHashIR) finalize() {
+	if c.disable {
+		c.headers, c.cookies, c.queryParameters, c.filterState, c.sourceIP = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil
+		c.hashPolicies = nil
+		return
+	}
+
+	c.headers = dedupeHashPolicies(c.headers, func(hp *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy) string {
+		// HTTP header names are case-insensitive
+		return strings.ToLower(hp.GetHeader().GetHeaderName())
+	})
+	c.cookies = dedupeHashPolicies(c.cookies, func(hp *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy) string {
+		return hp.GetCookie().GetName()
+	})
+	c.queryParameters = dedupeHashPolicies(c.queryParameters, func(hp *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy) string {
+		return hp.GetQueryParameter().GetName()
+	})
+	c.filterState = dedupeHashPolicies(c.filterState, func(hp *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy) string {
+		return hp.GetFilterState().GetKey()
+	})
+
+	policies := slices.Concat(c.headers, c.cookies, c.queryParameters, c.filterState)
+	if c.sourceIP != nil {
+		policies = append(policies, c.sourceIP)
+	}
+	if len(policies) == 0 {
+		policies = append(policies, sourceIPHashPolicy(false))
+	}
+	c.hashPolicies = policies
+}
+
+// dedupeHashPolicies returns a new slice keeping only the first occurrence of each key.
+func dedupeHashPolicies(
+	in []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy,
+	key func(*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy) string,
+) []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy {
+	if len(in) == 0 {
+		return nil
+	}
+	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(in))
+	out := make([]*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy, 0, len(in))
+	for _, hp := range in {
+		k := key(hp)
+		if _, ok := seen[k]; ok {
+			continue
+		}
+		seen[k] = struct{}{}
+		out = append(out, hp)
+	}
+	return out
+}
+
+// mergeConsistentHashIRs returns a new IR that is the union of high and low, where
+// entries from high take precedence over entries from low with the same key.
+// The sourceIp hash policy is always taken from high, even when unset.
+// Neither input is modified.
+func mergeConsistentHashIRs(high, low *consistentHashIR) *consistentHashIR {
+	out := &consistentHashIR{
+		headers:         slices.Concat(high.headers, low.headers),
+		cookies:         slices.Concat(high.cookies, low.cookies),
+		queryParameters: slices.Concat(high.queryParameters, low.queryParameters),
+		filterState:     slices.Concat(high.filterState, low.filterState),
+		sourceIP:        high.sourceIP,
+	}
+	out.finalize()
+	return out
+}
+
+// applyConsistentHash applies the consistent hash configuration to the Envoy route action.
+func applyConsistentHash(consistentHash *consistentHashIR, action *envoyroutev3.RouteAction) {
+	if consistentHash == nil || action == nil {
+		return
+	}
+	if consistentHash.disable {
+		action.HashPolicy = nil
+		return
+	}
+	action.HashPolicy = consistentHash.hashPolicies
+}
